item.title: Activists in Haiti say at least 30 people are dead after a gang attacks a town again
item.summary: Human rights activists in Haiti say at least 30 people are dead and dozens more are missing after a gang renewed its attack on a town in the country's central region

item.title: Oil-thirsty Asian nations seek Russian crude as Iran war strains supplies
item.summary: Asian nations are increasingly competing for Russian crude oil as an energy crisis mounts amid the U.S. and Israeli war in Iran, which has choked off roughly a fifth of the world’s oil supply

item.title: Pope Leo XIV urges an Easter end to the US-Israel war on Iran, calling for dialogue
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV expressed hope that the U.S.-Israel war on Iran could end before Easter

item.title: Czech police arrest a man who claimed responsibility for attack in Prague
item.summary: Czech police say they have arrested a foreign man who claims he threw Molotov cocktails at a Russian cultural center in Prague last week

item.title: Australian police fatally shoot suspect in 3-hour standoff after 2 officers killed
item.summary: Australian police believe they have shot dead a suspect accused of killing two police officers and seriously wounding a third in a remote forest region seven months ago

item.title: Unknown gunmen kill more than 70 in South Sudan after a dispute at a gold mine
item.summary: Gunmen have killed more than 70 people in South Sudan after a dispute at a gold mining site near the capital, Juba

item.title: Wolf bites woman in a shopping area in Germany's 2nd-biggest city
item.summary: Authorities say a wolf has bitten a woman in a Hamburg shopping area, in what experts call Germany’s first known wild wolf attack on a person since 1998

item.title: Cuba to introduce two new banknotes honoring women to ease inflation as crises persist
item.summary: Cubans accustomed to shopping with wads of bills stuffed into bags because of skyrocketing inflation will get some relief Wednesday when two new high-denomination banknotes go into circulation

item.title: Brazilian inmates find relief and reduce sentences through reading
item.summary: Brazil has a nationwide program that lets prisoners cut their sentences by reading books and proving they understood them

item.title: Cambodia advances a scam center law with penalties of up to life in prison
item.summary: Cambodia's lawmakers have passed legislation to crack down on online scam centers that have made the country a cybercrime hub
